Save initialized BPY_context_get() value (GIL-held pure getter), original G_MAIN and raw ParameterList scalar/pointer numeric values. Existing ParameterList storage remains owned until unconditional cleanup.

Perform initial WM null-C/null-output absence query. On owner-at-entry active-Main inputs, bind target/related IDs/Scene/override/newid/view-layer membership and native-admission receipt before FIRST CTX_data_main(C). Do not call any native first-read/admission using a stale wrapper-local pointer after provider execution.

Resolve implicit Main ONCE in this owned producer, then recapture active inputs even if provider removed every owner and no native Cancel occurred. Changed G_MAIN, UID/type/Library/override/relation/scene/view-layer or raw input values refuse before native mutation.

For actual mutating admitted cases, use existing default CallerContext registered-owner drain. Reconstruct and compare all receipts after EVERY successful WM call, including did_teardown=false, before return. Keep native no-op/error branches from causing unnecessary cancellation.

Check saved BPY context still current before dispatch. Call SAME exported native bodies with saved Main, current C, fresh resolved pointers and original raw scalar values. Never enter generated FUNC_USE_MAIN wrapper again, because that performs another provider lookup after receipt.

Borrowed generic RNA_function_call/generated/native routes must be absence-only and callback-free before any relevant old-frame read/query; exact identity selection should prevent bypass of owned producer or recursive cancellation. Do not let native body re-run a strict callback-bearing teardown after owned dispatch.

Write raw ID*/bool results into original ParameterList slots by fixed property identifiers; preserve native defaults/silent nullptr/false versus preflight report errors. Use bool, not int, for boolean parameter storage.

Python reports/refusal gate all return conversion. Refresh funcptr from the owned fresh target only when it is still valid and needed. Destroy succeeds with no output and may delete target: skip all post-return target/refinement/ancestor reads. Raw new-ID returns are converted from actual returned ID*, not presumed old target.

Always free ParameterList metadata/storage. Raw pointer slots and copied ancestor vectors are not ID refcounts and must not trigger disposal through freed targets. Do not add a generic late RNA property update; function bodies already own native tagging/notifiers.
